name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodupC_le
typeText:
∀ (l : List.{0} Nat),
  LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodupC l)
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (List.length.{0} l) (List.sum.{0} (List.map.{0, 0} DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.natC l)))

source.code:
theorem nodupC_le (l : List ℕ) : nodupC l ≤ l.length * (l.map natC).sum := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [nodupC]
  | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [nodupC, List.length_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [List.sum_map_add]
      have h1 : (l.map (fun _ => natC a)).sum = l.length * natC a := by
        simp [List.map_const']
      rw [h1]
      nlinarith [ih]
